learning_outcomes.text: The graduate has the ability to develop, design and create new applications, systems or products using best practices of the field.
The graduate has knowledge related to programming, mathematics, engineering and technology and has the skills to use them to create complex information technology systems.
The graduate has adequate knowledge related to the use of integrated development environments for creating large complex applications.
The graduate has the necessary skills for computer program design and software systems analysis.
The graduate is able to apply architectural styles, design patterns and best practices in the field to design software applications of high complexity.
The graduate has the ability to choose and use existing modules and environments for application development.
The graduate has the necessary knowledge for literature review.
The graduate is able to write a scientific/technical report.
The graduate has the ability to observe and obtain information from various sources.
Development and maintenance of software systems
Advanced programming skills in high-level programming languages
Application of scientific principles, to organized and creative and efficient work to rules, professional ethics and the didactic principles and norms

Use of efficient methods and techniques to learn, inform, research and develop the abilities to bring value to knowledge, to adapt at the requirements of a dynamical society and to communicate efficiently in Romanian language and in an international language

syllabus_topics: Assignment 1: Establishing the theme with the scientific coordinator.
Assignment 2: Creating the content of the paper + Develop a chapter from the theoretical part.
Assignment 3: Develop another chapter from the theoretical part. Develop the chapter for the application.
Assignment 4: Develop another chapter for the application. One functionality F1 of the application must be shown/executed.
Assignment 5: Presentation slides, Abstract+Introduction, Functionality F2 - execution.

assessment_methods.method: Grade given by Tutor (arithmetic average of the grades from the 5 laboratory assignments)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Grade given by Tutor + 0.5 * Grade given by Scientific Coordinator. To pass the subject, the final grade must be >= 5. Students must have a minimum of 4 attendances. Assignments delivered late are penalized by 2 points per laboratory delay. In the retake session, students can deliver undelivered assignments if they have at least 4 attendances; the tutor's grade for these assignments will be at most 6.
bibliography: to be decided by student based on his/her research topic
Internet resources on software projects and on the particular topics of the projects
